r3_1_whatTheNewVerifierFound.reading: four games fail their OWN self-test, on a check each calls offline or standalone that requires zero external script, link, img, audio, video or source elements. All four are tripped by their own link rel=canonical tag, which the browser never fetches, and three of them additionally carry the script src=/hud.js line the coverage ledger requires of a wired game. So the estate holds two rules that cannot both be satisfied by one file, and one of them counts a metadata tag as a network request. Reported, not worked around: the new verifier was not weakened to improve the number, and no game was touched.
